info.title: Ajar API
info.summary: Say yes faster — family web-approval backend.
info.description: Cross-platform parental URL-filtering backend: family model, policy engine, temporary approvals, access requests, and Ed25519-signed policy sync. Two bearer-token identities: **user tokens** (parents) and **device tokens** (issued at enrollment). Long-poll endpoints (`/policy/wait`, `/requests/wait`) deliver changes in seconds without streaming.

bearerAuth.description: HMAC bearer token. A **user token** (from /auth) or a **device token** (from /enroll/redeem), depending on the endpoint.

DevicePolicySnapshot.description: Signed, versioned policy snapshot for one child+device (the sync unit).

categories.description: Category → domain map for CATEGORY rules (e.g. { social: [...] }). Travels signed so clients enforce categories offline.

CategoryDatasetImport.description: Full replacement dataset: category slug → registrable domains.

SerializedBloom.description: One category's Bloom filter: m bits, k hashes, n elements, base64 bit array.

CategoryFilterAsset.description: The signed filter set. Verify `signature` (Ed25519, base64) over the canonical JSON of `set` with the policy public key before use.

TokenResponse.description: Access + refresh token pair. Send accessToken as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`; when it expires, POST refreshToken to /v1/auth/refresh. Both tokens are bound to one session (device) — see /v1/me/sessions.

SessionSummary.description: One signed-in device/session for the current user.

current.description: true if this is the calling token's session

get.summary: List categories with domain counts + dataset version
Look up which categories a host belongs to

put.summary: Replace the categorization dataset from a feed (ops)
put.description: Replaces the entire domain→category dataset. The bundled list is only a seed; import a maintained feed here without a code change.

get.description: Compact category-membership filters a child device downloads once and caches — local O(k) lookup, no per-URL call, no domain list in the app. Signed with the policy key; `?since=N` returns { upToDate: true } when unchanged.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Dataset version the device already has.

post.summary: Register a parent with a password
Exchange a refresh token for a fresh token pair
Sign out this device (revoke current session)

delete.summary: Revoke one session (remote sign-out of a device)

post.summary: Add a parent/guardian to the family

put.summary: Set a child's default policy (web + YouTube)

post.summary: Create a single-use device enrollment code
Redeem a code; register a device and get a device token

post.description: Requires a **device token**. The child device asks a parent to open one canonical target.

get.description: Returns the current PENDING list the instant it changes (create or decide), or the unchanged list after `timeout`. Pass `count` = the client's current pending length so an already-changed set returns immediately.

get.summary: Get the signed policy snapshot (device token)
get.description: Requires a **device token** matching `deviceId`. With `since=vN` returns `{upToDate:true}` when unchanged, else the new snapshot; without `since` returns the full current snapshot.

get.summary: Long-poll for a new policy snapshot (device token)
get.description: Requires a **device token**. Returns a fresh snapshot the moment an approval bumps the version past `since`, or `{upToDate:true}` after `timeout`.
